archetypes.name: dyn-rebase-routing
archetypes.rationale: Folded 7.r routing combines composite NEXT_ACTION and checkpoint KVs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed Step 6 checks-commit-route behavior and SKILL.md routing prose. Focus on whether the composite always emits exactly one NEXT_ACTION, relays CHECKPOINT_NEXT and rebase detail before it, and returns the probe rc without misrouting conflicts as invalid envelopes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
